name: Baka Sou Sou
source:
Warriors with their first love go all out. A quiet guy and his beautiful girlfriend star in this FF romance/gag/sex story. You'll laugh, you'll cry, you'll get totally turned on by the young adult characters in this FF adult adventure game!

An 8 page manga titled "Maicching! Ti*a Sensei" is also included.
translation:
初尝恋爱滋味的战士们全力以赴！沉默寡言的青年与他美貌的女友联袂主演这部《最终幻想》同人恋爱搞笑成人物语。在这部《最终幻想》成人冒险游戏中，年轻角色们的精彩演出定能让你开怀大笑、感动落泪，更是欲火高涨！

游戏内还附赠收录了共8页的短篇漫画《哎呀呀！蒂*老师》。
